categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in cybersecurity services, including internet security services, professional cybersecurity services, and cybersecurity product sales. It offers comprehensive cybersecurity solutions such as endpoint detection, network protection, penetration testing, SOC monitoring, incident response, and digital forensics. The company also develops proprietary cybersecurity products and SaaS services to enhance its competitive edge and expand internationally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced cybersecurity technologies including endpoint detection and response (EDR), network packet capture and analysis, end-to-end encryption with hardware security modules, AI-driven threat detection, and automated security orchestration (SOAR). It develops proprietary platforms for penetration testing, vulnerability scanning, and incident investigation, integrating international standards like ISO 27001 and ISO 27701 for information security and privacy management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include telecommunications operators (notably a major telecom group accounting for 20-30% revenue), government agencies, financial institutions, healthcare, high-tech, ICT sectors, critical infrastructure, enterprises, and individual consumers. The company serves a broad market from individual and household users to large enterprises requiring advanced cybersecurity protection and compliance with regulatory standards.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in Taiwan with nearly all revenue generated domestically, but it is actively expanding into international markets including the US, Swaziland, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Japan, Mongolia, Mexico, and Ukraine. It leverages partnerships with its parent telecom group’s overseas subsidiaries and local partners to penetrate foreign markets and support Taiwanese enterprises abroad.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly as a midstream cybersecurity service provider and product developer. It integrates cybersecurity software and hardware from upstream vendors, provides professional services and managed security operations, and delivers solutions directly to downstream end customers including enterprises and consumers. It also develops proprietary cybersecurity products to complement its service offerings.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding proprietary cybersecurity product development and SaaS offerings, enhancing AI and automation capabilities in security platforms, and broadening international market presence through local partnerships. The company plans to increase R&D investment significantly to innovate in cloud, network, endpoint, and encrypted communication security, while continuously improving service quality and capacity to meet growing cybersecurity demands.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through subscription-based internet security services (monthly or annual fees), professional cybersecurity consulting and managed services, and sales of cybersecurity hardware and software products. The company also benefits from licensing and service contracts with government, enterprise, and consumer clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading cybersecurity service provider in Taiwan, holding over 10% market share in the domestic cybersecurity operations services market. It competes with firms like AnQi Information, Digital Security, and Trade-Van Network. It distinguishes itself by continuous top government service ratings, extensive certifications, and a broad portfolio covering pre-incident detection, real-time monitoring, and post-incident forensics.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported revenues of approximately NT$1.97 billion, a 16% increase year-over-year, with net profit growing over 40%. It employs over 350 staff with a strong R&D investment ratio exceeding 5% of revenue. The company has demonstrated consistent growth in revenue, profitability, and market share, supported by expanding service demand and product innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes comprehensive, one-stop cybersecurity solutions combining advanced technology, expert services, and proprietary products. Its unique value lies in deep integration with a leading telecom network for broad internet security coverage, a highly certified and experienced technical team, continuous innovation in AI-driven security tools, and strong government and enterprise trust. This enables effective protection against evolving cyber threats with scalable, easy-to-deploy services.
